questions.q: Why does the Sales app's Home page look completely different from the Customer Service app's Home page?
options: Each app's Home page is configured separately by an admin to surface relevant content for that job function
Home pages are randomly generated each time a user logs in
Only one app in an org is allowed to have a Home tab
The Home page always looks identical across every app
questions.explain: Home pages are built per app using the Lightning App Builder, so an admin can surface completely different components depending on the job function the app serves.

questions.q: What happens to tabs that don't fit in the visible tabs bar?
options: They become permanently inaccessible
They are tucked behind a 'More' dropdown at the right edge of the tab bar
They are automatically deleted from the org
They are moved to a different app entirely
questions.explain: When there isn't room for every tab in the visible bar, Salesforce tucks the overflow behind a 'More' dropdown — the tabs are still accessible, just one extra click away.

questions.q: What is a 'list view' in Salesforce?
options: A single record's detail page
A filtered, sorted table showing a subset of an object's records
A type of report chart
The name for the App Launcher's search results
questions.explain: A list view is a filtered, sorted table of an object's records — clicking an object's tab opens a list view rather than dumping every record at once.

questions.q: Which of these can you do from inside a list view?
options: Only view records — sorting and filtering require a developer
Delete the entire object permanently
Sort by clicking a column header and filter by any field's value
Change the org's Salesforce edition
questions.explain: Inside a list view, users can sort by clicking column headers, filter by field values, switch between saved views, and create new list views — no developer needed.

questions.q: When creating a new list view, how can it be saved?
options: Privately, just for you, or shared with specific user groups
Only as a public view visible to the entire company, with no private option
List views cannot be saved; they are temporary only
Only an admin is permitted to save any list view
questions.explain: A new list view can be saved privately so only you see it, or shared with specific user groups, depending on who needs that particular slice of records.
